## Why Router Reliability is a Life-Line for Police, Fire, and EMS


In the public safety sector—covering Police, Fire, and EMS—the stakes are high. A router failure doesn’t just mean a lost connection; it means a lost life-line for a Mobile Data Terminal (MDT), Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD), or body-cam upload, potentially impacting officer safety.[Aviat’s Aprisa LTE 5G router](https://aviatnetworks.com/products/aprisa-lte) is designed and built to be a secure, rugged, and cost-effective alternative for your next fleet refresh cycle. And even better – it is **made and supported right here in the USA** .

Choosing the right 5G router for Police, Fire, and EMS comes down to three things: reliability, security, and total cost of ownership. As our benchmarking shows, the **[Aviat Aprisa LTE 5G router](https://aviatnetworks.com/products/aprisa-lte/)** leads the pack with faster deployment speeds, ruggedized QMA connectors, and hardware-level data isolation that exceeds standard VLANs. Most importantly, it returns control to the agency—eliminating the risk of “bricked” hardware and mandatory SaaS fees. Don’t let your fleet’s connectivity become a bottleneck during an emergency.
